fields.title: Your Dashboard: The Heart of Your Journey
fields.description: Your personalized command center that transforms your daily data into meaningful insights.
fields.content:
## Why Your Dashboard Matters

Your Dashboard isn't just a home page—it's **your personal life intelligence center**. Every journal entry, health measurement, prayer, and task you log feeds into this view to give you:

- **Patterns you can't see yourself** - The AI notices trends across weeks and months
- **Timely nudges** - Gentle reminders when you're drifting from your intentions
- **Celebrations** - Recognition of progress that keeps you motivated
- **Action items** - What needs your attention today, prioritized by what matters most

### How Your Data Becomes Insight

When you log a journal entry, the AI analyzes your mood patterns. When you track your weight, it notices trends. When you complete tasks, it learns your productivity rhythms. **The more you use Whole Life Journey, the smarter your Dashboard becomes.**

---

## Personalize Your AI Experience

The quality of your AI insights depends on two key settings in **Preferences**:

### 1. AI Coaching Style
Choose how the AI communicates with you:
- **Supportive Partner** - Warm, encouraging
- **Direct Coach** - Brief, action-focused
- **Gentle Guide** - Patient, nurturing
- **Wise Mentor** - Thoughtful, reflective
- **Cheerful Friend** - Upbeat, positive
- **Calm Companion** - Steady, peaceful
- **Accountability Partner** - Motivating, focused

### 2. Complete Your Profile
The AI uses your profile information to personalize insights:
- Your **name** for personal greetings
- Your **goals** in the Goals module
- Your **faith preferences** for spiritual context
- Your **timezone** for accurate daily insights

**Tip:** Go to **Preferences > AI Settings** to select your coaching style, and fill out your **Profile** and **Goals** sections for the most relevant insights.

---

## Dashboard Components

### Quick Stats (Top Row)
Clickable tiles showing your current status:
- **Journal Streak** - Consecutive days of journaling (click to see entries)
- **Tasks Today** - Today's task count (click to manage tasks)
- **Active Prayers** - Open prayer requests (click to view)
- **Medicine Doses** - Today's medications (click to track)
- **Workouts This Week** - Weekly exercise count (click to log more)

### Today's Insight
An AI-generated observation personalized to your coaching style. This isn't generic advice—it's based on YOUR recent activity, mood patterns, and goals.

### Celebrations
Recognition of your wins, big and small. Completing a 7-day journal streak? Hitting your protein goal? We celebrate progress here.

### Accountability Nudges
Gentle reminders about:
- Goals you set but haven't worked on
- Habits that have slipped
- Medicines that need refills
- Tasks that are overdue

### Today's Priorities
If you've enabled the Personal Assistant, you'll see AI-suggested priorities ordered by what matters most to you.

---

## Tips for a Powerful Dashboard

1. **Check it daily** - Even a 30-second glance keeps you connected
2. **Log consistently** - The more data you provide, the smarter your insights
3. **Set your coaching style** - In Preferences, pick how the AI talks to you
4. **Fill out your profile** - Name, goals, and purpose help personalize insights
5. **Enable AI features** - Turn on the Personal Assistant for maximum value
6. **Click the tiles** - Each stat is a direct link to that feature

---

## Related Features
- **Personal Assistant** - Get AI-powered daily priorities and guidance
- **Journal** - Your entries power mood and pattern analysis
- **Health Tracking** - Feeds weight, nutrition, and vital trends
- **Preferences** - Set your AI coaching style and profile

fields.title: Navigating Your Whole Life Journey
fields.description: Master the app layout and discover how everything connects.
fields.content:
## Why Good Navigation Matters

Whole Life Journey brings together many aspects of your life—journal, health, faith, goals, and more. Understanding the layout helps you **capture thoughts quickly** when inspiration strikes and **find information easily** when you need it.

---

## The Big Picture: How It All Connects

Think of Whole Life Journey as a **personal life operating system**:

| Module | What You Log | What the AI Learns |
|--------|--------------|--------------------|
| **Journal** | Thoughts, moods, reflections | Emotional patterns, triggers |
| **Health** | Weight, nutrition, medicine, vitals | Physical trends, adherence |
| **Faith** | Prayers, scripture, milestones | Spiritual journey, answered prayers |
| **Organize** | Tasks, projects, events | Productivity patterns |
| **Goals** | Goals, intentions, directions | What matters most to you |

**Everything feeds into your Dashboard**, where AI turns raw data into actionable insights.

---

## Main Navigation

### Top Navigation Bar
- **Dashboard** - Your daily home base with insights
- **Journal** - Record thoughts and track moods
- **Faith** - Prayers, scripture, spiritual growth (if enabled)
- **Health** - Weight, nutrition, medicine, vitals, fitness
- **Organize** - Tasks, projects, events, documents
- **Goals** - Goals, annual direction, change intentions
- **Scan** 📷 - Camera scan for food, medicine, documents

### User Menu (Avatar Icon)
Click your profile picture in the top-right:
- **Profile** - Your account information
- **Preferences** - Customize themes, modules, AI settings
- **What's New** - Recent feature updates
- **Sign Out** - Log out securely

### Help Icon (?)
Available on every page—click for context-specific guidance.

---

## Mobile Navigation

On phones and tablets:
1. Tap the **☰ menu icon** to open the navigation drawer
2. All modules are accessible from the drawer
3. Swipe to close or tap outside

---

## Tips for Efficient Navigation

1. **Use Dashboard tiles** - Click the stat tiles for direct access
2. **Bookmark the Dashboard** - Make it your browser home page
3. **Enable only what you need** - Disable unused modules in Preferences
4. **Use keyboard shortcuts** - Press `?` to open help on any page

fields.title: Journal: The Foundation of Self-Awareness
fields.description: Your journal entries power AI insights about your emotional patterns and life rhythms.
fields.content:
## Why Journaling Changes Everything

Your journal isn't just a diary—it's the **primary data source for your AI insights**. Every entry you write teaches the system about:

- **Your emotional patterns** - When do you feel best? What triggers stress?
- **Your life rhythms** - Busy seasons, restful periods, recurring challenges
- **Your growth** - How far you've come, patterns you've broken
- **Your values** - What you write about reveals what matters

### The Dashboard Connection

When you journal consistently:
- Your **Daily Insight** becomes more personalized and relevant
- The AI notices **mood trends** you might miss
- Your **Journal Streak** tile celebrates consistency
- The Personal Assistant can suggest **reflection prompts** based on your patterns

---

## Personalize Your Journal AI Insights

The AI-generated prompts and insights respond to your settings:

### Set Your Coaching Style
In **Preferences > AI Settings**, choose how the AI communicates:
- **Direct Coach** gives brief, action-focused prompts
- **Gentle Guide** offers patient, nurturing suggestions
- **Wise Mentor** provides thoughtful, reflective questions

### Complete Your Profile & Goals
The AI crafts better prompts when it knows:
- Your **name** for personal touches
- Your **Annual Direction** and goals
- Your **faith preferences** for spiritual prompts
- Your recent **mood patterns** from previous entries

**Tip:** The more you fill out your Profile and Goals sections, the more relevant your reflection prompts become.

---

## How to Use the Journal

### Creating an Entry
1. Click **"New Entry"** from the Journal page
2. Enter a title (or leave blank for auto-date title)
3. Select your current **mood** from the dropdown
4. Write your thoughts in the body field
5. (Optional) Add **categories** to organize entries
6. Click **"Save"** to create your entry

### Mood Tracking
Selecting your mood with each entry enables:
- Mood trend charts over time
- AI insights about what affects your emotional state
- Pattern detection (e.g., "You tend to feel anxious on Mondays")

### Viewing Past Entries
- Entries display newest first by default
- Click any title to read the full entry
- Use the calendar view to browse by date
- Filter by mood or category to find specific entries

---

## Tips for Powerful Journaling

1. **Write at the same time daily** - Morning or evening, consistency builds the habit
2. **Don't aim for perfection** - Even three sentences count toward your streak
3. **Be honest** - The AI learns from authentic entries, not polished ones
4. **Set your coaching style** - In Preferences, choose how AI prompts speak to you
5. **Review monthly** - Read old entries to see your own growth
6. **Use prompts** - The Personal Assistant can suggest what to write about

---

## What Your Journal Teaches the AI

| What You Write | What the AI Learns |
|----------------|--------------------|
| Daily moods | Emotional patterns over time |
| Challenges mentioned | Recurring struggles to address |
| Wins and gratitude | What brings you joy |
| Goals referenced | Progress toward intentions |
| Relationships mentioned | Who matters in your life |

---

## Related Features
- **Dashboard** - See your journal streak and mood-based insights
- **Personal Assistant** - Get personalized journaling prompts
- **Goals** - Connect journal reflections to your life goals
- **Preferences** - Set your AI coaching style

fields.title: Health: Track What You Can Measure
fields.description: Your health data powers trend analysis and helps you make informed decisions.
fields.content:
## Why Track Your Health?

**What gets measured gets managed.** The Health module helps you:

- **See trends** you can't feel day-to-day (gradual weight changes, blood pressure patterns)
- **Stay accountable** to your health goals with visual progress
- **Inform conversations** with your doctor using real data
- **Receive smart insights** as the AI notices patterns in your health data

### The Dashboard Connection

Your health data appears on your Dashboard as:
- **Weight progress** toward your goal (if set)
- **Nutrition summary** showing calories and macros
- **Medicine tracker** with today's doses
- **Fitness count** for the week
- **AI nudges** when you haven't logged in a while

---

## Health Sub-Modules

### Weight Tracking
**Why:** See long-term trends, not daily fluctuations
- Log weight with optional notes
- View progress charts over weeks/months
- Set a goal weight in Preferences
- AI notices trends and plateaus

### Nutrition / Food Tracking
**Why:** Understand what you eat, hit your macro goals
- Log meals with calories and macros
- Use Camera Scan for instant food logging
- Track meal timing and eating pace
- Set calorie and macro goals in Preferences

### Medicine Tracking
**Why:** Never miss a dose, track adherence over time
- Set up your medication schedule
- One-tap daily check-off
- See adherence percentages
- Get refill alerts before you run out

### Vitals (Blood Pressure & SpO2)
**Why:** Monitor cardiovascular health between doctor visits
- Log readings with context (resting, morning, etc.)
- Automatic categorization (normal, elevated, high)
- See trends over time

### Fasting
**Why:** Track intermittent fasting windows
- Start/end fasting with one tap
- View fasting history and patterns
- Track your fasting streaks

### Fitness / Workouts
**Why:** Build exercise consistency
- Log workouts with type and duration
- Use templates for common routines
- Track weekly workout counts

### Medical Providers
**Why:** Keep all your healthcare contacts organized
- Store doctor/clinic contact info
- AI-assisted provider lookup
- Track staff and portal access

---

## Tips for Better Health Tracking

1. **Log at the same time daily** - Morning weigh-ins, evening food reviews
2. **Use Camera Scan** - Photograph meals for quick logging
3. **Set realistic goals** - In Preferences, set targets you'll actually hit
4. **Check your trends** - Weekly patterns matter more than daily numbers
5. **Enable SMS reminders** - Get medicine reminders via text

---

## Related Features
- **Camera Scan** - Photograph food for instant nutrition logging
- **Dashboard** - See today's health summary at a glance
- **Personal Assistant** - Get health-related priorities and nudges
- **Preferences** - Set weight and nutrition goals

fields.title: Faith: Nurture Your Spiritual Journey
fields.description: Track prayers, scripture, and spiritual milestones to see God's faithfulness over time.
fields.content:
## Why Track Your Faith Journey?

Faith isn't just about the present moment—it's about **seeing God's faithfulness over time**. The Faith module helps you:

- **Remember answered prayers** you might otherwise forget
- **Track spiritual growth** through milestones and reflections
- **Build consistency** in scripture reading and prayer
- **See patterns** in your spiritual life the AI can surface

### The Dashboard Connection

With Faith enabled, your Dashboard shows:
- **Active Prayer count** - Quick access to your prayer list
- **Faith-based insights** - AI considers your spiritual journey in daily insights
- **Faith-first priorities** - The Personal Assistant prioritizes faith over other areas
- **Answered prayer celebrations** - Recognition when God responds

---

## Faith Features

### Prayer Requests
**Why:** Never forget what you're praying for—and celebrate when God answers

1. Click **"New Prayer"** to add a request
2. Set priority (Normal or Urgent)
3. Mark as **Answered** when God responds
4. View your history of answered prayers

**The power of tracking:** Months later, review your answered prayers. You'll be amazed at God's faithfulness in ways you forgot.

### Scripture
**Why:** Save verses that speak to you for easy reference

- Search for verses by reference
- Save favorites with personal notes
- Organize by topic or theme
- Review during difficult times

### Faith Milestones
**Why:** Mark the moments that shaped your faith journey

Record significant spiritual moments:
- Salvation experience
- Baptism
- Answered prayers
- Spiritual insights
- Community moments
- Ministry experiences

---

## How Faith Integrates with the AI

When faith is enabled, the Personal Assistant:
- **Prioritizes faith first** - Spiritual matters appear before other priorities
- **Suggests prayer time** - Gentle reminders to connect with God
- **Notices patterns** - When you haven't prayed or read scripture in a while
- **Celebrates faithfulness** - Acknowledges spiritual consistency

---

## Tips for Spiritual Growth

1. **Log prayers as you pray them** - Don't wait until later
2. **Update prayer status promptly** - Mark answered when it happens
3. **Review answered prayers monthly** - Build your faith by remembering
4. **Connect journal to faith** - Reflect spiritually in your journal entries
5. **Enable SMS reminders** - Get daily prayer reminders

---

## Related Features
- **Journal** - Write about spiritual experiences
- **Personal Assistant** - Faith-first daily priorities
- **SMS Notifications** - Daily prayer reminders via text
- **Dashboard** - Active prayer count and faith insights

fields.title: Preferences: Make It Yours
fields.description: Customize your experience, set goals, and control how the AI interacts with you.
fields.content:
## Why Preferences Matter

Whole Life Journey adapts to YOU, not the other way around. Your Preferences control:

- **What you see** - Enable only the modules you'll actually use
- **How it looks** - Choose themes and colors that inspire you
- **How the AI talks** - Pick a coaching style that motivates you
- **Your goals** - Set weight, nutrition, and other targets
- **Your notifications** - Control SMS reminders and alerts

### The More You Customize, The Better It Works

Setting clear goals in Preferences means:
- Your Dashboard shows **progress toward YOUR targets**
- The AI gives you **relevant, personalized insights**
- You stay focused on **what matters to you**

---

## Preference Categories

### Theme & Appearance
**Why:** Work in an environment that inspires you

- **Theme** - Choose from Minimal, Faith, Sports, Nature, Outdoors
- **Accent Color** - Pick a custom highlight color
- **Dark/Light Mode** - Follows your system or set manually

### Module Toggles
**Why:** Only see what's relevant to your life

Enable or disable:
- Journal
- Faith (prayers, scripture, milestones)
- Health (weight, nutrition, medicine, vitals)
- Organize (tasks, projects, events)
- Goals (goals, directions)

Disabled modules disappear from navigation.

### AI Settings
**Why:** Get insights that actually help you

- **Enable AI** - Turn on intelligent insights across the app
- **Coaching Style** - How the AI communicates with you:
  - Supportive Partner (warm, encouraging)
  - Direct Coach (brief, action-focused)
  - Gentle Guide (patient, nurturing)
  - Wise Mentor (thoughtful, reflective)
  - Cheerful Friend (upbeat, positive)
  - Calm Companion (steady, peaceful)
  - Accountability Partner (motivating, focused)

### Personal Assistant
**Why:** Get daily priorities and proactive guidance

- **Enable Personal Assistant** - Adds the Assistant to your navigation
- **Consent** - The Assistant needs deeper data access for personalization

### Weight & Nutrition Goals
**Why:** Track progress toward specific targets

- **Target Weight** - Your goal weight with optional deadline
- **Daily Calories** - Your calorie target
- **Macro Split** - Protein/Carbs/Fat percentages
- Presets: Balanced, High Protein, Low Carb, Keto

### SMS Notifications
**Why:** Get reminders where you'll see them

- **Verify Phone** - Add and verify your phone number
- **Categories** - Choose which reminders you want
- **Quiet Hours** - No texts during sleep

### Timezone & Location
**Why:** Accurate times and local context

- Set your timezone for correct streak tracking
- Location enables weather-aware insights

---

## Tips for Optimal Settings

1. **Start with fewer modules** - Add more as you build the habit
2. **Try different coaching styles** - Change it up if one doesn't resonate
3. **Set realistic goals** - Better to exceed than constantly fall short
4. **Enable the Personal Assistant** - It's the most powerful feature
5. **Use SMS reminders** - Texts are harder to ignore than app badges

fields.title: Organize: Your Daily Operating Layer
fields.description: Manage the practical stuff—tasks, projects, events—so nothing falls through the cracks.
fields.content:
## Why Use the Organize Module?

The Organize module is where **intentions become action**. While Goals holds your big-picture goals, Organize holds the daily tasks that move you toward them. The connection matters:

- **Tasks completed** feed into your Dashboard productivity stats
- **Overdue tasks** trigger AI accountability nudges
- **Project progress** shows in your weekly trend analysis
- **Events** integrate with SMS reminders so you never miss important dates

### The Dashboard Connection

Your Organize data powers:
- **Tasks Today** tile showing your daily count
- **Overdue task nudges** in your accountability section
- **Productivity patterns** the AI tracks weekly
- **Event reminders** via SMS if enabled

---

## Organize Features

### Tasks
**Why:** Capture everything so your brain can relax

1. Click **"New Task"** to create a task
2. Set a title and optional description
3. Choose priority: Now, Soon, or Later
4. Add due date for time-sensitive items
5. Link to a project if part of larger work

**Priority levels:**
- **Now** - Do today
- **Soon** - This week
- **Later** - Someday

### Projects
**Why:** Break complex work into manageable pieces

1. Click **"New Project"** to create a project
2. Set status: Active, Paused, or Completed
3. Add tasks that belong to this project
4. Track progress as tasks complete

**Project-Task connection:** Completing project tasks updates your overall project progress automatically.

### Events
**Why:** Never miss important dates

- Add events with dates and times
- Set location and notes
- View your week at a glance
- Get SMS reminders 30 minutes before

### Additional Features

- **Inventory** - Track your belongings and their locations
- **Pets** - Manage pet records, vet visits, care schedules
- **Recipes** - Save your favorite recipes
- **Documents** - Store important document references

---

## How Organize Connects to Goals

The ideal flow:
1. Set **Annual Direction** in Goals (your word/theme for the year)
2. Create **Life Goals** that align with that direction
3. Break goals into **Projects** in Organize
4. Break projects into **Tasks**
5. Complete tasks daily → Projects complete → Goals achieved → Direction fulfilled

The AI sees this entire chain and helps keep you aligned.

---

## Tips for Task Management

1. **Do a daily review** - Check your task list each morning
2. **Use the Now/Soon/Later system** - Don't over-prioritize
3. **Link tasks to projects** - See the bigger picture
4. **Complete tasks promptly** - Don't let the list grow stale
5. **Enable task SMS reminders** - Get due date notifications

---

## Related Features
- **Goals** - Your goals that tasks support
- **Dashboard** - Today's task count and productivity patterns
- **Personal Assistant** - Task-related priorities
- **SMS Notifications** - Task due date reminders

fields.title: Goals: Your North Star
fields.description: Define what matters most so your daily actions align with your deeper values.
fields.content:
## Why Goals Matter Most

Goals is the **anchor** for everything else in Whole Life Journey. Without it, you're just logging data. With it, every task, journal entry, and health metric connects to **what you actually want from life**.

### The AI Connection

When you set Goals content, the AI can:
- **Detect drift** - Notice when your actions don't match your stated intentions
- **Prioritize wisely** - Suggest priorities aligned with your goals
- **Celebrate alignment** - Acknowledge when you're living your purpose
- **Ask better questions** - Generate journal prompts connected to your direction

---

## Goals Features

### Annual Direction
**Why:** Give your year focus and meaning

1. **Word of the Year** - A single guiding word (e.g., "Growth", "Peace", "Discipline")
2. **Core Theme** - What you want to accomplish this year
3. **Focus Areas** - Key life domains to prioritize

**Review quarterly** to ensure you're still on track.

### Life Goals
**Why:** Define what success looks like

1. Click **"New Goal"** to create a goal
2. Add milestones to break it into steps
3. Track progress as you advance
4. Link to projects and tasks in the Organize module

**Goal categories:**
- Health & Wellness
- Personal Growth
- Relationships
- Career
- Financial
- Spiritual

### Change Intentions
**Why:** Capture what you want to improve

- Record areas for personal growth
- Set intentions for positive change
- Review periodically for accountability

---

## How Goals Powers the AI

| What You Set | How the AI Uses It |
|--------------|--------------------|
| Word of the Year | References it in daily insights |
| Goals | Prioritizes related tasks |
| Change Intentions | Watches for drift |
| Focus Areas | Filters what matters |

---

## The Goals Cascade

```
Annual Direction (the "why")
    ↓
Life Goals (the "what")
    ↓
Projects (the "how", in Organize module)
    ↓
Tasks (the daily "do")
```

The AI understands this hierarchy and helps you stay connected from daily tasks to yearly goals.

---

## Tips for Purposeful Living

1. **Set your Annual Direction first** - Everything else flows from this
2. **Limit to 3-5 goals** - Focus beats breadth
3. **Review monthly** - Are you moving toward your goals?
4. **Connect to Organize module** - Create projects and tasks from goals
5. **Journal about goals** - Reflect on alignment regularly

---

## Related Features
- **Organize** - Tasks and projects that execute your goals
- **Journal** - Reflect on goal alignment
- **Personal Assistant** - Drift detection and goal reminders
- **Dashboard** - Goal progress and goal-aligned insights

fields.title: Task List
fields.description: View and manage all project tasks.
fields.content:
## Task List

This page shows all tasks across all projects with filtering options.

### Filtering Tasks

Use the filter controls to narrow the list:
- **Phase** - Filter by phase number
- **Status** - Filter by task status (backlog, ready, in_progress, done, blocked)
- **Project** - Filter by project

### Task Status Workflow

1. **Backlog** - Task created, not ready for work
2. **Ready** - Task marked ready, available for Claude
3. **In Progress** - Claude is actively working on it
4. **Done** - Task completed successfully
5. **Blocked** - Task waiting on dependency or issue

### Mark Ready

For backlog tasks, use the **"Mark Ready"** button to make them available for Claude to execute.

### Inline Editing

Some fields can be edited inline:
- Status can be changed via dropdown
- Priority can be adjusted

### Sorting

Tasks are sorted by priority (ascending) then creation date.

fields.title: Nutrition: Fuel Your Body Intentionally
fields.description: Track what you eat to understand your patterns and hit your macro goals.
fields.content:
## Why Track Nutrition?

You can't manage what you don't measure. Nutrition tracking helps you:

- **Understand your patterns** - When do you overeat? Undereat protein?
- **Hit your goals** - See exactly where you stand on calories and macros
- **Identify triggers** - Connect eating habits to mood, stress, and time of day
- **Make informed choices** - Know the impact before you eat

### The Dashboard Connection

Your nutrition data powers:
- **Today's Nutrition** summary with calorie and macro progress
- **AI insights** about eating patterns
- **Personal Assistant** nudges when you're off-target
- **Trend analysis** showing weekly and monthly patterns

---

## How to Log Food

### Method 1: Camera Scan (Fastest)
1. Click **Scan** in the navigation
2. Point camera at your food or nutrition label
3. AI identifies the food and estimates nutrition
4. Review and save the pre-filled entry

### Method 2: Quick Add
1. From Nutrition page, click **"Quick Add"**
2. Enter food name and basics (calories at minimum)
3. Save quickly without full detail

### Method 3: Full Entry
1. Click **"Add Food Entry"**
2. Fill in all nutritional details
3. Add meal type, location, eating pace
4. Include hunger/fullness levels for mindful eating

---

## Tracking Details

### Meal Types
- Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack

### Location Context
- Home, Restaurant, Work, Travel, Other

### Eating Pace
- Rushed, Normal, Slow/Mindful

### Hunger & Fullness
- 1-5 scale to build mindful eating awareness

---

## Setting Nutrition Goals

In **Preferences > Weight & Nutrition Goals**:

1. **Daily Calorie Goal** - Your target intake
2. **Macro Split** - Protein/Carbs/Fat percentages
3. Use presets: Balanced, High Protein, Low Carb, Keto

Once set, your Dashboard shows progress bars for each.

---

## Tips for Successful Tracking

1. **Log before you eat** - Easier than remembering later
2. **Use Camera Scan** - AI does the work for packaged foods
3. **Don't aim for perfection** - Close estimates beat no data
4. **Review weekly trends** - Daily variation is normal
5. **Create custom foods** - Save your common meals for quick logging

---

## Related Features
- **Camera Scan** - Photograph food for instant logging
- **Dashboard** - Today's nutrition summary
- **Preferences** - Set calorie and macro goals
- **Personal Assistant** - Nutrition-related priorities

fields.title: Medicine Tracking: Never Miss a Dose
fields.description: Track your medications, monitor adherence, and get refill reminders.
fields.content:
## Why Track Medicine?

Medication adherence is one of the most impactful health behaviors—and one of the hardest to maintain. Medicine tracking helps you:

- **Never miss a dose** - Visual schedules and SMS reminders
- **Build consistency** - See your adherence rate over time
- **Catch refill needs early** - Alerts before you run out
- **Inform your doctor** - Share accurate adherence data at appointments

### The Dashboard Connection

Your medicine data appears on your Dashboard as:
- **Medicine Doses** tile with today's status
- **Adherence insights** from the AI
- **Refill alerts** in the nudges section
- **Trend analysis** in weekly reports

---

## Setting Up Medicines

### Adding a Medicine
1. Go to **Health > Medicine**
2. Click **"Add Medicine"**
3. Enter: Name, dose, frequency
4. Set schedule: days and times
5. Add doctor and pharmacy (optional)
6. Set refill alert threshold

### Schedule Options
- **Daily** - Same times every day
- **Specific days** - Weekly medications
- **PRN (As Needed)** - Track when you take it

---

## Daily Tracking

### One-Tap Check-Off
1. Visit **Health > Medicine** each day
2. See today's schedule with status badges
3. Tap to mark as **Taken**, **Missed**, or **Skipped**

### Status Badges
- 🟢 **Taken** - Dose completed
- 🟡 **Pending** - Not yet due
- 🔴 **Overdue** - Past due time
- ⚪ **Skipped** - Intentionally skipped

### SMS Reminders
Enable in **Preferences > SMS Notifications**:
- Get text reminders at scheduled times
- Reply **D** for Done, **R** for Remind Me, **N** for Skip
- Log doses directly from text messages

---

## Refill Tracking

### Setting Up Refill Alerts
1. Enter **current quantity** and **pills per dose**
2. System calculates days remaining
3. Alert triggers at your set threshold

### Refill Request Tracking
1. When low, click **"Request Refill"**
2. Status changes to "Refill Requested"
3. Dashboard shows pending refill
4. When received, click **"Refill Received"**

---

## Adherence Tracking

### View Your Adherence
- **Daily view** - Today's completion rate
- **Weekly view** - 7-day adherence percentage
- **Monthly view** - Long-term consistency
- **By medicine** - See which meds you miss most

### Quick Look
Click **"Quick Look"** for a screenshot-friendly view of your medicine list—great for sharing with doctors.

---

## Tips for Better Adherence

1. **Enable SMS reminders** - Text messages are harder to ignore
2. **Use consistent times** - Same time each day builds habit
3. **Log immediately** - Don't wait until later
4. **Review weekly** - Identify patterns in missed doses
5. **Pause when needed** - Pause medications without losing history

---

## Related Features
- **SMS Notifications** - Medicine reminders via text
- **Dashboard** - Today's medicine status
- **Camera Scan** - Photograph medicine bottles to add
- **Personal Assistant** - Medicine-related priorities

fields.title: Camera Scan: AI-Powered Quick Entry
fields.description: Photograph items to instantly log food, medicine, documents, and more.
fields.content:
## Why Use Camera Scan?

Camera Scan removes the friction from logging. Instead of typing nutritional data or medicine names, just **point and shoot**:

- **Food/Nutrition** - Photograph meals or nutrition labels for instant macro entry
- **Medicine** - Scan bottles to add medications
- **Documents** - Capture important papers
- **Receipts** - Log expenses quickly

### The Time Savings

Manual food entry: 2-3 minutes per meal
Camera scan: 10 seconds

Over a week, that's **30+ minutes saved** on food logging alone.

---

## How to Use Camera Scan

### Taking a Photo
1. Click **Scan** in the main navigation
2. Grant camera permission if prompted
3. Point at your item (food, medicine, document)
4. Tap **capture** or use file upload
5. Wait for AI analysis (2-5 seconds)

### What the AI Detects

| Item Type | What Happens |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Packaged Food** | Identifies brand, looks up nutrition facts |
| **Home-Cooked Food** | Estimates portions and macros |
| **Nutrition Label** | Reads and extracts all data |
| **Medicine Bottle** | Extracts name, dose, pharmacy |
| **Document** | Categorizes and offers to save |
| **Receipt** | Extracts items and totals |

### After Analysis

You'll see:
- What the AI identified
- Pre-filled form with extracted data
- Suggested actions (log food, add medicine, etc.)
- Option to edit before saving

---

## Food Recognition Details

### For Packaged Foods
- AI identifies brand and product name
- Looks up actual nutritional data
- Returns calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugar
- Includes standard serving size

### For Home-Cooked/Restaurant Food
- AI estimates portion size visually
- Uses nutritional databases for identified ingredients
- Considers visible preparation methods
- Estimates are good approximations, not exact

---

## Tips for Best Results

1. **Good lighting** - Natural light works best
2. **Clear focus** - Make sure text is readable
3. **Include labels** - Nutrition facts labels give best accuracy
4. **Whole plate visible** - For portion estimation
5. **Steady hand** - Avoid blur

---

## Privacy & Security

- **No permanent storage** - Images are processed and deleted
- **Encrypted transmission** - Your photos are secure
- **No sharing** - Data stays in your account only
- **Optional** - You can always use manual entry instead

---

## Related Features

- **Medicine Tracking** - Where medicine scans end up

- **AI Settings** - Camera scan requires AI to be enabled

fields.title: Personal Assistant: Your AI-Powered Guide
fields.description: Get daily priorities, trend analysis, and proactive guidance based on your data.
fields.content:
## Why Use the Personal Assistant?

The Personal Assistant isn't a chatbot or cheerleader—it's a **task-focused guide** that helps you take action. Unlike the Dashboard (which shows data), the Assistant tells you **what to do next**.

### Dashboard vs Personal Assistant

| Feature | Dashboard | Personal Assistant |
|---------|-----------|--------------------|
| Purpose | Shows your data | Interprets your data |
| Focus | Celebrates wins | Highlights gaps |
| Style | Passive display | Proactive suggestions |
| Output | General insights | Specific priorities |

---

## Personalize Your Assistant

The Assistant adapts its communication style and priorities based on your settings:

### 1. Set Your AI Coaching Style
In **Preferences > AI Settings**, choose how the Assistant talks to you:
- **Direct Coach** - Brief, action-focused ("Do this now.")
- **Supportive Partner** - Warm, encouraging ("You've got this!")
- **Accountability Partner** - Motivating, focused ("Stay on track.")
- **Gentle Guide** - Patient, nurturing ("When you're ready...")
- **Wise Mentor** - Thoughtful, reflective ("Consider this...")

### 2. Complete Your Profile & Goals
The Assistant gives better priorities when it knows:
- Your **name** for personal greetings
- Your **Annual Direction** and word of the year
- Your **goals** in the Goals module
- Your **faith preferences** for priority ordering

**Important:** Without a completed Profile and Goals, the Assistant can only give generic suggestions. Fill these out for truly personalized guidance.

---

## Personal Assistant Features

### Daily Priorities
Each morning, the Assistant analyzes your data and suggests:
1. What needs attention today
2. Ordered by importance (faith first, then purpose, then maintenance)
3. Completable with one click

### Opening Message
A brief daily check-in that:
- Acknowledges your current state
- Highlights what matters today
- Sets the tone based on your coaching style

### Trend Analysis
- **Weekly Analysis** - Patterns from the last 7 days
- **Monthly Analysis** - Bigger-picture trends
- **Drift Detection** - When your actions don't match your intentions

### Reflection Prompts
Personalized journaling suggestions based on:
- Your recent activity
- Gaps in your tracking
- Goals you've set
- Patterns the AI notices

---

## Priority Ordering (Faith-First)

If you have Faith enabled, priorities follow this order:

1. **Faith** - Prayer, scripture, spiritual practices
2. **Goals** - Goals and annual direction
3. **Long-term goals** - Active goal milestones
4. **Commitments** - Tasks and events
5. **Maintenance** - Health tracking, routines
6. **Optional** - Nice-to-haves

This ensures what matters most gets attention first.

---

## Using the Assistant

### Viewing Priorities
1. Click **Assistant** in the navigation
2. See today's priorities with action buttons
3. Click to complete, dismiss, or get details

### Chatting
- Ask questions about your data
- Get clarification on priorities
- Request analysis of specific areas

### Completing Priorities
- Click ✓ when done
- Priority marked complete (not regenerated today)
- Contributes to completion stats

---

## Enabling the Personal Assistant

The Assistant requires extra consent because it accesses more of your data:

1. Go to **Preferences > AI Settings**
2. Enable **AI Features** if not already
3. Enable **Personal Assistant**
4. Accept the consent for deeper data access
5. Assistant link appears in navigation

---

## What the Assistant Sees

To provide useful guidance, the Assistant analyzes:
- Journal entries and mood patterns
- Health data and adherence rates
- Task completion and overdue items
- Prayer requests and faith activity
- Goal progress and drift from intentions

**This is why separate consent is required.**

---

## Tips for Getting Value

1. **Check it daily** - Morning review of priorities
2. **Complete promptly** - Mark done when you finish
3. **Log consistently** - Better data = better suggestions
4. **Set clear Goals** - The AI needs to know your intentions
5. **Read weekly analysis** - Big-picture patterns are revealing

---

## Related Features
- **Dashboard** - Where insights appear
- **Goals** - Your goals that drive priorities
- **Journal** - Reflection prompts link here
- **Preferences** - Enable/configure the Assistant

fields.title: SMS Notifications: Reminders Where You'll See Them
fields.description: Get text message reminders for medicines, tasks, events, and more. (NOTE: SMS feature not yet launched — topic preserved for future use.)
fields.content:
## Why SMS Notifications?

App notifications are easy to ignore. Text messages aren't. SMS notifications ensure you:

- **Never miss a medicine dose** - Texts arrive at scheduled times
- **Stay on top of tasks** - Due date reminders via text
- **Remember events** - 30-minute advance notice
- **Can respond quickly** - Reply to log without opening the app

### The Quick Reply System

When you get a medicine reminder, reply:
- **D** (Done) - Mark taken immediately
- **R** (Remind) - Get another reminder in 5 minutes
- **N** (No/Skip) - Skip this dose

No app needed. Just text back.

---

## Setting Up SMS

### Step 1: Add Your Phone
1. Go to **Preferences > SMS Notifications**
2. Enter your phone number
3. Click **"Send Verification Code"**
4. Enter the 6-digit code you receive
5. Phone is now verified

### Step 2: Enable SMS
1. Toggle **"Enable SMS Notifications"** on
2. Accept the SMS consent

### Step 3: Choose Categories
Select which reminders you want:
- ✅ Medicine reminders
- ✅ Medicine refill alerts
- ✅ Task due date reminders
- ✅ Event reminders
- ✅ Prayer reminders (if Faith enabled)
- ✅ Fasting reminders

### Step 4: Set Quiet Hours
No texts during sleep:
- Set start time (e.g., 10:00 PM)
- Set end time (e.g., 7:00 AM)
- Reminders queue until quiet hours end

---

## Notification Types

| Type | When Sent | Example |
|------|-----------|----------|
| Medicine | At scheduled time | "Time for Metformin. Reply D/R/N" |
| Refill Alert | When supply low | "Low supply: Metformin (3 days left)" |
| Task Due | On due date | "Due today: Buy groceries" |
| Event | 30 min before | "In 30 min: Doctor appt" |
| Prayer | Morning | "Take a moment for prayer today" |
| Fasting | Window times | "Eating window opens at noon" |

---

## Reply Codes

| You Text | What Happens |
|----------|-------------|
| D, done, yes, taken | Mark complete |
| R, R5, R10, R30 | Remind in X minutes |
| N, no, skip | Skip/dismiss |

Codes are case-insensitive.

---

## Costs

SMS is a premium feature with real carrier costs:
- Outbound: ~$0.008/message
- Inbound: ~$0.008/message

**Example:** 3 medicine reminders/day = ~$0.72/month

Your site admin manages the Twilio account.

---

## Tips for Best Use

1. **Start with medicine only** - Most impactful category
2. **Set appropriate quiet hours** - Avoid late-night texts
3. **Use reply codes** - Faster than opening the app
4. **Check SMS history** - View all sent messages in app

---

## Related Features
- **Medicine Tracking** - Primary use case for SMS
- **Life Events** - Event reminders via SMS
- **Preferences** - Configure all SMS settings
- **Faith** - Daily prayer reminders

fields.title: Vitals: Monitor Your Cardiovascular Health
fields.description: Track blood pressure and blood oxygen to spot trends between doctor visits.
fields.content:
## Why Track Vitals?

Vitals like blood pressure and blood oxygen change gradually. By tracking them yourself, you can:

- **Catch trends early** - Gradual changes are hard to feel
- **Prepare for appointments** - Bring real data to your doctor
- **Understand your patterns** - Morning vs evening, resting vs stressed
- **Get categorization** - Know if readings are normal, elevated, or concerning

### The Dashboard Connection

Your vitals data appears on:
- **Health home page** - Latest readings with category badges
- **AI insights** - Patterns and trends over time
- **Personal Assistant** - Alerts for concerning readings

---

## Blood Pressure Tracking

### Logging a Reading
1. Go to **Health > Blood Pressure**
2. Click **"Log Reading"**
3. Enter systolic (top number) and diastolic (bottom number)
4. Add pulse if you know it
5. Select context (resting, morning, post-exercise, etc.)
6. Note which arm and your position
7. Save

### Categories (AHA Guidelines)

| Category | Systolic | Diastolic |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| 🟢 Normal | <120 | AND <80 |
| 🟡 Elevated | 120-129 | AND <80 |
| 🟠 High Stage 1 | 130-139 | OR 80-89 |
| 🔴 High Stage 2 | ≥140 | OR ≥90 |
| ⚫ Crisis | ≥180 | OR ≥120 |

### Context Options
- Resting, Morning, Evening
- Post-Exercise, Stressed, Relaxed
- At Doctor's Office

---

## Blood Oxygen (SpO2) Tracking

### Logging a Reading
1. Go to **Health > Blood Oxygen**
2. Click **"Log Reading"**
3. Enter SpO2 percentage
4. Add pulse if available
5. Select context and measurement method
6. Save

### Categories

| Category | SpO2 |
|----------|------|
| 🟢 Normal | ≥95% |
| 🟡 Low | 90-94% |
| 🟠 Concerning | 85-89% |
| 🔴 Critical | <85% |

### Measurement Methods
- Finger pulse oximeter
- Wrist device
- Ear clip
- Other

---

## Tips for Accurate Tracking

### Blood Pressure
1. **Sit quietly for 5 minutes** before measuring
2. **Same time daily** for comparable readings
3. **Arm at heart level** for accuracy
4. **Avoid caffeine/exercise** for 30 minutes before
5. **Take 2-3 readings** and log the average

### Blood Oxygen
1. **Warm hands** for better readings
2. **Remove nail polish** if using finger
3. **Stay still** during measurement
4. **Resting readings** are most useful for trends

---

## Related Features
- **Health Home** - Vitals cards with quick access
- **Dashboard** - AI notices concerning patterns
- **Medical Providers** - Share data with your doctor
- **Personal Assistant** - Vitals-related priorities

fields.title: Glucose Tracking: Monitor Your Blood Sugar
fields.description: Track glucose readings manually or via Dexcom CGM integration with AI-powered insights.
fields.content:
## Why Track Glucose?

Blood sugar management is essential for metabolic health. Glucose tracking helps you:

- **See patterns over time** - Understand how food, stress, and activity affect your levels
- **Stay in range** - Monitor your time in target zone (70-180 mg/dL)
- **Get AI insights** - Personalized observations based on your glucose data
- **Connect with Dexcom** - Automatic CGM data import for hands-free tracking

### The Dashboard Connection

Your glucose data appears on:
- **Health home page** - Latest reading with trend arrow
- **AI insights** - Analysis of your glucose patterns
- **Personal Assistant** - Blood sugar related priorities

---

## Personalize Your Glucose Insights

The AI adapts its glucose insights based on your settings:

### Set Your AI Coaching Style
In **Preferences > AI Settings**, choose how insights are delivered:
- **Direct Coach** - Concise facts and actions
- **Supportive Partner** - Encouraging observations
- **Gentle Guide** - Patient, non-judgmental feedback

### Complete Your Profile
Better insights when the AI knows:
- Your **health goals** in the Goals module
- Your **faith preferences** for spiritual health encouragement
- Your typical **eating patterns** from nutrition tracking

**Tip:** Go to Preferences to set your coaching style, and fill out your Profile for more relevant glucose insights.

---

## Understanding Your Readings

### Glucose Levels (mg/dL)

| Category | Range | What It Means |
|----------|-------|---------------|
| Very Low | <54 | Seek immediate treatment |
| Low | 54-69 | Consider eating fast-acting carbs |
| Normal/Target | 70-180 | Healthy range for most people |
| High | 181-250 | Above target, monitor trends |
| Very High | >250 | Consider contacting your doctor |

### Reading Contexts

- **Fasting** - First thing in the morning, before eating
- **Before Meal** - Just before eating
- **After Meal (2 hours)** - Two hours post-meal
- **Bedtime** - Before sleep
- **Random** - Any other time
- **CGM Reading** - Continuous monitor data

---

## Dexcom CGM Integration

### What is CGM?
Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) uses a small sensor to measure glucose every 5 minutes, giving you a complete picture of your blood sugar patterns without finger sticks.

### Connecting Dexcom
1. Go to **Health > Glucose**
2. Click **"Connect Dexcom"**
3. Log in to your Dexcom account
4. Authorize Whole Life Journey to access your data
5. Readings sync automatically

### Sync Features
- **Automatic import** - New readings appear within minutes
- **Trend arrows** - See which direction your glucose is heading
- **Historical data** - Import up to 90 days of past readings
- **Manual sync** - Force a sync anytime from the dashboard

### Trend Arrows Explained

| Arrow | Meaning | Rate of Change |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| ⬆⬆ | Rising Rapidly | >3 mg/dL/min |
| ⬆ | Rising | 2-3 mg/dL/min |
| ↗ | Rising Slowly | 1-2 mg/dL/min |
| → | Stable | <1 mg/dL/min |
| ↘ | Falling Slowly | 1-2 mg/dL/min |
| ⬇ | Falling | 2-3 mg/dL/min |
| ⬇⬇ | Falling Rapidly | >3 mg/dL/min |

---

## Dashboard Stats

### Time in Range
The percentage of readings between 70-180 mg/dL. Target: 70% or higher for most people.

### Average Glucose
Your mean glucose reading for the selected time period. Provides a snapshot of overall control.

### Min/Max Values
The lowest and highest readings in the period. Helps identify extreme swings.

### Low/High Counts
Number of readings below 70 mg/dL (low) or above 180 mg/dL (high). Fewer is better.

---

## AI Glucose Insights

When AI is enabled, you'll receive personalized insights based on:

### What the AI Analyzes
- **Reading patterns** - Time of day trends
- **Time in range** - How often you're in target
- **Low/high frequency** - Concerning patterns
- **Trend direction** - Current glucose trajectory
- **Your coaching style** - Insights match your preferred communication

### AI Insight Parameters
The AI considers:
- **Reading count** - More data = more accurate insights
- **Average glucose** - Overall level for the period
- **Min/Max readings** - Range of your glucose swings
- **Time in range %** - Percentage in 70-180 mg/dL
- **Low count** - Number of readings below 70
- **High count** - Number of readings above 180
- **Latest value** - Your most recent reading
- **Latest status** - Category of current reading

### Faith-Enabled Insights
If faith is enabled, insights may include:
- Spiritual encouragement for health stewardship
- Scripture-inspired perspectives on self-care
- Faith-based motivation for wellness

---

## Manual Logging

### When to Log Manually
- If you don't have a CGM
- For finger-stick meter readings
- When CGM is warming up or unavailable

### How to Log
1. Click **"Log Reading"** on the glucose dashboard
2. Enter your glucose value
3. Select the unit (mg/dL or mmol/L)
4. Choose the context (fasting, before meal, etc.)
5. Add optional notes
6. Save

---

## Time Period Views

### Available Periods
- **Today** - Today's readings only
- **7 Days** - Last week (default)
- **30 Days** - Last month
- **60 Days** - Last two months
- **90 Days** - Last quarter

Longer periods help identify trends; shorter periods show recent patterns.

---

## Tips for Better Glucose Tracking

1. **Connect Dexcom if you have it** - Automatic tracking is more complete
2. **Log context consistently** - Knowing fasting vs after-meal matters
3. **Check trends, not just numbers** - The arrow tells you where you're heading
4. **Review weekly patterns** - Look for recurring highs or lows
5. **Share data with your doctor** - Use the glucose list for appointments

---

## Related Features
- **Health Home** - Glucose card with latest reading
- **Nutrition Tracking** - Food affects glucose levels
- **Personal Assistant** - Glucose-related priorities
- **Dashboard** - AI insights about your health data

fields.title: Capture: Record, Transcribe, and Summarize Audio
fields.description: Record or upload audio to get AI-powered transcripts and summaries of sermons, meetings, and more.
fields.content:
## Why Use Capture?

Capture transforms spoken content into searchable, reviewable text. Perfect for:

- **Sermons and teachings** - Never miss a key insight from your pastor
- **Meetings and lectures** - Get automatic notes without manual effort
- **Voice memos** - Quickly capture thoughts and get them organized
- **Interviews and conversations** - Create transcripts for reference

### The Power of AI Transcription

Capture doesn't just record—it **understands**. Each recording is:
1. **Transcribed** - Full text of everything spoken
2. **Summarized** - Key points extracted by AI
3. **Categorized** - Organized by type (Faith, Organize)
4. **Searchable** - Find recordings by keyword

---

## How to Use Capture

### Method 1: Record Directly
1. Click **Capture** in the navigation
2. Click **"Record"**
3. Grant microphone permission if prompted
4. Click the record button to start
5. Speak naturally—capture works with any audio
6. Click stop when finished
7. Add title, category, and subcategory
8. Submit for processing

### Method 2: Upload Audio File
1. Click **Capture** in the navigation
2. Click **"Upload"**
3. Select an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, etc.)
4. Add title, category, and subcategory
5. Submit for processing

### After Submission
- Processing takes 1-5 minutes depending on length
- You can leave the page—you'll be notified when complete
- The detail page updates automatically with transcript and summary

---

## Categories and Subcategories

### Faith Category
For spiritual content:
- **Sermon** - Sunday messages, guest speakers
- **Bible Study** - Group studies, lessons
- **Devotional** - Personal devotion recordings
- **Prayer** - Recorded prayers, prayer meetings
- **Testimony** - Personal stories of faith
- **Worship** - Music and worship recordings
- **Other Faith** - Anything else spiritual

### Organize Category
For practical content:
- **Meeting** - Work meetings, team calls
- **Lecture** - Educational content, courses
- **Interview** - Job interviews, podcasts
- **Brainstorm** - Idea sessions, planning
- **Voice Memo** - Quick thoughts, reminders
- **Other** - Everything else

---

## What You Get

### Full Transcript
- Complete text of everything spoken
- Timestamped (coming soon)
- Searchable and copyable

### AI Summary
- **Key Points** - Main takeaways extracted
- **Action Items** - Things to follow up on (when applicable)
- **Themes** - Major topics discussed

### Audio Playback
- Listen again anytime
- Adjustable playback speed
- Download for offline listening

---

## Finding Your Recordings

### Filtering
- **By Category** - Show only Faith or Organize
- **By Subcategory** - Narrow down further (Sermons only, Meetings only, etc.)

### Searching
- Search titles and summaries
- Find that sermon about "forgiveness" or meeting about "Q3 goals"

### Sorting
- Newest first by default
- Click column headers to re-sort

---

## Processing Status

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|--------|
| **Processing** | AI is transcribing and summarizing |
| **Ready** | Complete—view transcript and summary |
| **Failed** | Something went wrong (retry available) |

### If Processing Fails
- Click **"Retry"** to try again
- Common causes: very long audio, poor audio quality
- Failed attempts don't count against you

---

## Audio Storage

Audio files are stored securely in the cloud:
- **7-day retention** - Audio files are automatically cleaned up

fields.title: Cycle Tracking: Understand Your Body's Rhythms
fields.description: Track your menstrual cycle, log daily symptoms, view predictions, and discover patterns in your cycle data.
fields.content:
## Why Track Your Cycle?

Understanding your menstrual cycle helps you:

- **Anticipate your period** - Know when to expect it based on your patterns
- **Track symptoms** - Identify what's normal for YOU each cycle
- **Spot patterns** - Connect mood, energy, and symptoms to cycle phases
- **Get AI predictions** - Receive personalized period and fertility forecasts
- **Share with providers** - Give your doctor accurate cycle data

### The Dashboard Connection

When cycle tracking is enabled:
- **Current phase display** - See which cycle phase you're in
- **Days until period** - Countdown to predicted start
- **AI insights** - Phase-aware guidance based on your cycle
- **Symptom trends** - Patterns the AI notices over time

---

## Understanding Cycle Phases

Your cycle is divided into four phases, each with typical characteristics:

### Menstrual Phase (Days 1-5)
**Color:** Red
- Period bleeding occurs
- Energy may be lower
- Common: cramps, fatigue, headaches
- Self-care focus: rest, comfort

### Follicular Phase (Days 6-13)
**Color:** Orange
- Body prepares for ovulation
- Energy typically increases
- Mood often improves
- Good time for new projects

### Ovulation Phase (Days 14-16)
**Color:** Green
- Peak fertility window
- Highest energy for many
- May feel most social
- Important for fertility awareness

### Luteal Phase (Days 17-28)
**Color:** Blue
- Post-ovulation, pre-period
- PMS symptoms may appear
- Energy may decrease
- Self-care becomes important

**Note:** Phase timing adjusts to YOUR cycle length. If your cycle is 32 days, phases scale proportionally.

---

## Daily Logging

### What to Log Each Day

**Flow Level** - Track bleeding intensity:
- None - No flow
- Spotting - Very light/occasional
- Light - Light flow
- Medium - Normal flow
- Heavy - Heavy flow

**Symptoms** - Select what you're experiencing:
- Cramps
- Headache
- Fatigue
- Bloating
- Breast tenderness
- Acne
- Backache
- Nausea
- Food cravings
- Insomnia

**Mood** - How are you feeling emotionally?
- Happy, Sad, Irritable, Anxious
- Calm, Energetic, Tired, Emotional

**Energy Level** - Rate 1-5:
- 1 = Very low energy
- 5 = Very high energy

**Optional Fertility Tracking:**
- Cervical mucus type
- Basal body temperature
- Notes for any day

### Tips for Logging
1. **Log at the same time daily** - Consistency improves accuracy
2. **Don't skip days** - Even "nothing happening" days matter
3. **Be honest** - The AI learns from accurate data
4. **Add notes** - Context helps you remember later

---

## Automatic Period Detection

The app automatically detects your period:

### How It Works
- When you log flow (light/medium/heavy), a new cycle may start
- After 2+ days of no flow, the period is considered ended
- Spotting doesn't trigger new cycles
- Previous cycles close automatically

### Manual Adjustments
If detection isn't right:
- Edit daily logs to correct flow levels
- Admin can manually adjust cycle records
- Recalculate option available for data cleanup

---

## AI Predictions

### What Gets Predicted
- **Next period start date** - When to expect your period
- **Period end date** - Based on your average period length
- **Fertile window** - If fertility tracking is enabled
- **Confidence score** - How reliable the prediction is

### How Predictions Work
- Uses weighted moving average of last 3-6 cycles
- Recent cycles weighted more heavily
- Confidence based on cycle regularity (standard deviation)
- Minimum 3 completed cycles needed

### Confidence Levels
| Level | Meaning |
|-------|--------|
| High (80%+) | Very regular cycles (std dev < 2 days) |
| Medium (60-79%) | Fairly regular (std dev 3-4 days) |
| Low (40-59%) | Some variation (std dev 5-6 days) |
| Very Low (<40%) | Irregular cycles (std dev 7+ days) |

**Tip:** More logged cycles = better predictions. Log consistently for best accuracy.

---

## Statistics & Insights

### What You Can View

**Cycle Length Stats:**
- Average cycle length
- Shortest/longest cycles
- Standard deviation

**Period Length Stats:**
- Average period length
- Variation over time

**Symptom Frequency:**
- Which symptoms occur most often
- Percentage of days with each symptom

**Mood by Phase:**
- How your mood correlates with cycle phases
- Dominant mood per phase

**Regularity Score:**
- 0-100 score based on consistency
- Excellent/Good/Fair/Irregular rating

**Trends:**
- Are your cycles getting longer or shorter?
- Based on linear regression analysis

---

## Privacy & Opt-In

### Enabling Cycle Tracking

Cycle tracking is **opt-in** for privacy:

1. **During Onboarding:** If you select "Female" as gender, tracking is auto-enabled
2. **In Preferences:** Toggle cycle tracking on/off anytime
3. **Via Health Menu:** Enable from the Health section

### Your Data is Private
- Only you can see your cycle data
- No sharing without your explicit consent
- Export available in JSON or CSV format
- Data can be deleted anytime

---

## Data Export

### Export Formats

**JSON Export:**
- Complete nested structure
- Settings, daily logs, cycles, predictions
- Best for data portability

**CSV Export:**
- Flattened for spreadsheets
- Separate files per data type
- Easy to analyze in Excel/Sheets

### What's Included
- All settings and preferences
- Complete daily log history
- All cycle records
- Prediction history
- No personal identifiers in metadata

---

## Tips for Effective Cycle Tracking

1. **Log every day** - Even days with "nothing" help the algorithm
2. **Start with flow level** - This is the most important data point
3. **Add symptoms as they happen** - Don't wait until end of day
4. **Review your stats monthly** - See what patterns emerge
5. **Trust the predictions** - They improve with more data
6. **Use phase info** - Plan activities around your energy levels

---

## Related Features
- **Dashboard** - Current phase and days until period
- **Health Home** - Quick access to cycle logging
- **Personal Assistant** - Phase-aware daily priorities
- **Preferences** - Enable/disable cycle tracking

fields.title: Heart Rate: Track Your Pulse

fields.content:
## Why Track Heart Rate?

### The Dashboard Connection

Your heart rate data appears on:

## How to Log Heart Rate

4. Select the context (resting, morning, post-exercise, etc.)

### Measurement Tips
- **Resting heart rate** - Measure first thing in the morning, before getting out of bed
- **Post-exercise** - Wait 2-3 minutes after stopping for recovery rate
- **Consistent timing** - Measure at the same time daily for best comparisons

---

## Understanding Your Readings

### Resting Heart Rate (Adults)

| Category | BPM Range |
|----------|----------|
| Athlete | 40-60 |
| Excellent | 60-65 |
| Good | 65-70 |
| Average | 70-75 |
| Below Average | 75-80 |
| Poor | 80+ |

**Note:** Individual variation is normal. What matters most is YOUR trend over time.

### Context Options
- **Resting** - Sitting quietly for 5+ minutes
- **Morning** - Just woken up, still in bed
- **Post-Exercise** - After physical activity
- **Stressed** - During emotional or physical stress

## Your Stats

The heart rate page shows:

- **Resting average** - Mean of resting/morning readings

## Tips for Effective Tracking

1. **Log your resting heart rate daily** - Morning readings are most consistent
2. **Note the context** - Context helps interpret your readings
3. **Use the same method** - Wrist, chest, or device - stay consistent
4. **Track over weeks** - Single readings matter less than trends

fields.title: Fasting: Track Your Eating Windows
fields.description: Monitor intermittent fasting with simple start/stop tracking.
fields.content:
## Why Track Fasting?

Intermittent fasting can support weight management and metabolic health. Tracking helps you:

- **Stay consistent** - Know exactly how long you've fasted
- **Build streaks** - See your consistency over time
- **Find your rhythm** - Discover what eating window works for you

---

## How Fasting Works Here

### Starting a Fast
1. Go to **Health > Fasting**
2. Click **"Start Fast"**
3. Your fast timer begins immediately
4. Optionally add notes or planned duration

### Ending a Fast
1. Visit the fasting page
2. Click **"End Fast"** on your active fast
3. Duration is automatically calculated

### One Active Fast at a Time
You can only have one active fast. End your current fast before starting a new one.

---

## Common Fasting Schedules

| Method | Fast | Eat | Example |
|--------|------|-----|--------|
| 16:8 | 16 hours | 8 hours | Eat noon-8pm |
| 18:6 | 18 hours | 6 hours | Eat 1pm-7pm |
| 20:4 | 20 hours | 4 hours | Eat 2pm-6pm |
| OMAD | ~23 hours | ~1 hour | One meal/day |

**Start simple:** 16:8 is a good beginner schedule.

---

## Your Fasting Stats

The fasting page shows:
- **Active fast** - Current timer if fasting
- **Recent fasts** - Your history with durations
- **Average duration** - Your typical fast length
- **Streak** - Consecutive days with a completed fast

---

## Tips for Successful Fasting

1. **Stay hydrated** - Water, black coffee, and plain tea are fine
2. **Start gradually** - Begin with 12 hours and work up
3. **Listen to your body** - End early if needed; don't force it
4. **Be consistent** - Same eating window daily helps
5. **Log every fast** - Even short ones build the habit

---

## Related Features
- **Nutrition** - Track what you eat during your window
- **Health Home** - Quick view of fasting status
- **Dashboard** - Fasting patterns in AI insights

fields.title: Habit Goals: Build Consistency
fields.description: Track daily habits with four measurement types, streaks, and smart insights.
fields.content:
## Why Track Habits?

Small daily actions compound into big results. Habit tracking helps you:

- **Build consistency** - Visual streaks motivate daily action
- **Measure progress** - See completion rates and trends
- **Get insights** - Smart recommendations based on your patterns
- **Stay accountable** - Know exactly what you did and when

---

## Measurement Types

When creating a habit, choose the type that fits:

### Binary (Yes/No)
Simple daily check-off. Did you do it today?
- Example: "Read my Bible", "Take vitamins", "Make bed"
- Click **"I Did It Today!"** to log

### Duration (Timed)
Track how long you spend on something.
- Example: "Meditate 10 min", "Practice guitar 30 min"
- Use the built-in **timer** with start/pause/stop
- Circular progress ring shows target progress
- Timer state saves locally (close browser and come back)

### Count (Repetitions)
Track how many times you do something.
- Example: "50 pushups", "8 glasses of water", "3 chapters"
- Use **+/− buttons** to count up
- Progress bar shows target completion

### Target (Hit a Number)
Track a numeric value toward a target.
- Example: "10,000 steps", "2000 calories", "7 hours sleep"
- Enter your value with the **numeric input**
- Running total tracks daily progress

---

## Logging Habits

### Quick Click Logging
- **Progress matrix** - Click any missed or today box to log instantly
- **Calendar** - Click any day to log that date
- **Shift+click** - Select a range of dates
- **Ctrl/Cmd+click** - Select multiple individual dates

### Undo
Every log action shows an **undo toast** with an 8-second countdown. Click "Undo" to reverse the action.

---

## Streaks

Streaks track your consecutive completions:
- **Daily habits** - Consecutive days completed
- **Weekly habits** - Consecutive weeks meeting your sessions target
- **Monthly habits** - Consecutive months with completion

Look for the flame icon next to your streak count. A warning icon appears when your streak is **at risk** (you haven't logged today yet).

---

## Smart Insights

The system analyzes your patterns and offers insights:
- **Milestone celebrations** - 7, 30, 60, 90, 365 day streaks
- **Target adjustments** - Suggestions to increase/decrease when your completion rate is very high or low
- **Day patterns** - Notices which days you tend to miss
- **Trend warnings** - Alerts when your consistency is declining

Insights can be **applied** (updates your target) or **dismissed**.

---

## Tips for Habit Success

1. **Start small** - A 5-minute habit beats a skipped 30-minute one
2. **Stack habits** - Attach new habits to existing routines
3. **Don't break the chain** - Streaks are powerful motivation
4. **Review weekly** - Check your completion rate and adjust
5. **Use the timer** - For duration habits, the timer keeps you honest

---

## Related Features
- **Dashboard** - Habit goals tile shows today's status
- **Goals** - Habits connect to your broader life goals
- **AI Assistant** - Ask about your habit patterns
- **Calendar** - Visual month view of completions

fields.title: Body Composition: Track Your Measurements

fields.content:
## What is Body Composition?

Body composition tracking captures performance-based measurements separate from clinical lab work. This includes data from gym scans, smart scales, tape measurements, and DEXA scans.

---

## What You Can Track

### Common Metrics
- **Body Fat %** - Percentage of body weight that is fat
- **Lean Mass** - Weight minus fat (muscle, bone, water)
- **Fat Mass** - Total fat weight
- **Skeletal Muscle Mass** - Active muscle tissue

### Body Measurements
- Waist, Chest, Hips
- Arms (Left/Right), Thighs (Left/Right)
- Neck, Shoulders, Calves, Forearms

### Advanced Metrics
- Bone Mass, Body Water %
- Visceral Fat Index, BMR, Metabolic Age
- **Custom metrics** - Add any measurement type you want

---

## How to Log

1. Go to **Health > Body Composition**
2. Click **"Log Measurement"**
3. Select the metric type (or choose Custom)
4. Enter value and unit (auto-suggested based on metric)
5. Set the measurement date and source
6. Add optional notes
7. Click **Log Measurement** or **Save & Add Another** for batch entry

---

## Sources

Track where measurements come from:
- Manual Entry, Smart Scale, DEXA Scan
- Bod Pod, InBody Scanner, Gym Body Scan
- Apple Health, Other

---

## Tips

1. **Measure consistently** - Same time of day, same conditions
2. **Use the same device** - Different scales give different readings
3. **Track trends, not single readings** - Daily fluctuations are normal

fields.title: Health Insights: Cross-Domain Patterns
fields.description: View observational insights generated from your health data across multiple domains.
fields.content:
## What Are Health Insights?

The Insight Engine analyzes patterns across your health data and generates observational, non-directive insights. These insights describe what the data shows without providing advice or recommendations.

---

## Insight Types

### Trend
Describes directional movement in your data:
- "Weight trend has declined over 6 weeks."
- "Body fat percentage trending downward."

### Consistency
Highlights regular patterns:
- "Goal has an 85% completion rate."
- "Current streak of 14 days."

### Gap
Identifies periods without logging:
- "No weight entries logged in the past 30 days."
- "No journal entries in the past 30 days."

### Correlation
Connects patterns across domains:
- "Lean mass stable during weight reduction."
- "Both weight and lean mass have increased."

---

## Domains Covered

Insights can span across:
- **Weight** - Weight trends and rate of change
- **Body Composition** - Body fat, lean mass, measurements
- **Goals** - Health-related goal completion rates
- **Habits** - Streak tracking and consistency
- **Journal** - Writing frequency patterns

---

## How It Works

1. Go to **Health > Insights**
2. Click **"Refresh Insights"** to generate new analysis
3. Review your insights
4. Dismiss any you've already noted

Each insight shows:
- **Type badge** - Trend, Consistency, Gap, or Correlation
- **Confidence score** - Based on how much data was available
- **Related domains** - Which areas of your data contributed

---

## Important Note

WLJ provides educational insights based on user-entered data. This information is not medical advice. Individual results vary.

fields.title: Today's Guidance
fields.description: Evidence-based guidance items on your dashboard.
fields.content:
## Today's Guidance

The Today's Guidance panel on your dashboard shows the most important insights, warnings, and encouragement generated by your intelligence engines.

### How Items Are Generated
Guidance items come from three sources:
- **State** — Generated from your current life data (e.g., you haven't journaled in 5 days)
- **Insight** — Triggered by patterns the AI detected (e.g., your weight is trending down)
- **Prediction** — Based on projected trends (e.g., you may miss a goal deadline)
- **Guidance** — Composite items combining multiple signals

### What Each Action Does
- **I did it** (checkmark) — Marks the item as acted upon. Use this when you've taken the suggested action.
- **Snooze** (zzz) — Hides the item for 24 hours. It will reappear after that.
- **Dismiss** (X) — Permanently removes the item from your active list.

### Confidence Scores
Some items show a confidence score (e.g., "Confidence: 0.86"). This appears only for prediction-based guidance and tells you how certain the system is about the projected trend.

### View All Guidance
Click "View all guidance" at the bottom of the panel to see your complete guidance history, including dismissed and snoozed items.

### Tips
1. Items are ranked by priority — critical items appear first
2. Acting on guidance helps the system learn what's useful to you
3. Dismissing items you find unhelpful is encouraged — it keeps your dashboard clean
